title: Core: edge-served redirects for urls.style clean (alias and slug-rename redirects target /x.html)
description: engine.py renames and CMS alias redirects use request_paths_for_key, which gives /x.html for a clean-style page. Use UrlPolicy.url_for_key.

comments.text: Merged in Papyrus PR #464 (b1f1467), released in 5.10.0+, deployed fleet-wide on 5.12.0. 7954f8: redirects use the projector's public path. 9cd419: placeholder escape, empty leading column fix, site.dateFormat/ledeField, groupBy field:<name>, seo.articleTypes. 2c3c69: seo.isBasedOnField, live on cyclotron.anth.us articles (JSON-LD isBasedOn).
